title: Asking what one thing is
focus: Build the bounded question Mikä tämä on? and its tuo and se counterparts.

exercises.prompt: Choose the sentence that means “What is this object?” At a study desk. Use tämä (“this”), esine (“object”), and on (“is”).
exercises.explanation: The singular identity frame begins with Mikä and ends with on.

sentenceExplanation.pattern: question word + demonstrative noun phrase + linking verb at the end of the question

parts.role: linking verb at the end of the question

optionFeedback.Mikä tämä esine on?: Correct. The singular identity frame begins with Mikä and ends with on.
optionFeedback.Mitä tämä esine on?: “Mitä” is the plural classification-question word used in this bounded frame; use “Mikä”, the singular identity-question word used in this bounded frame.
optionFeedback.Tämä esine on?: “Tämä” is a singular nominative form for a referent near the speaker; use “Mikä”, the singular identity-question word used in this bounded frame.
optionFeedback.Mikä tämä esine ovat?: “ovat” is the plural affirmative form of olla; use “on”, the singular affirmative form of olla.
